note: Shared TS<->Go drift guard for @hdml/hash.bytesToBase64 + hashify (Slice E, RFC 004 Decision E). Byte-identical copy asserted by the Go test in this package AND the @hdml/hash Jest suite (Step 04). Do NOT edit an expected value without the other side's test failing. `base64` = @hdml/hash.bytesToBase64(content_utf8) — the exact string hashify consumes on the FE, reproduced in Go by hash.BytesToBase64 (NOT encoding/base64 StdEncoding). `std` = encoding/base64 StdEncoding of the same bytes, recorded ONLY to document the divergence: for content whose byte length is not a multiple of 3, bytesToBase64 emits 'A' value-padding where StdEncoding emits '=' (see the mod1/mod2 cases). `hashify` = hashify(base64), always 8 chars — never ~6 as the upstream JSDoc claims. Cases cover all three length residues (mod0 no pad, mod1 two 'A' pads, mod2 one 'A' pad). Values generated from the real @hdml/hash cjs build, not hand-computed.
